mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CS.* FROM TR_CAR_SPEC CS WHERE REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(CS.MAKER)), ' ', '') = REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(#{maker})), ' ', '') AND REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(CS.CAR_NM)), ' ', '') = REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(#{carName})), ' ', '') ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT AREA, VALUE AS BOND_RATE, BOND_GB, CAR_GB, BASE1, BASE2, START_DT, END_DT FROM TM_BOND WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN START_DT AND END_DT AND LOWER(TRIM(CAR_GB)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{carGb})) AND UPPER(TRIM(BOND_GB)) = 'N' AND #{baseValue} >= NVL(BASE1, 0) AND #{baseValue} < NVL(BASE2, 999999999) AND ( TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE TRIM(AREA) || '%' OR (TRIM(AREA) = '강원도' AND TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE '강원특별자치도%') OR (TRIM(AREA) = '강원특별자치도' AND TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE '강원도%') OR (TRIM(AREA) = '전라북도' AND TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE '전북특별자치도%') OR (TRIM(AREA) = '전북특별자치도' AND TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE '전라북도%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(BOND_GB)) = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN TRIM(#{baseAddress}) LIKE TRIM(AREA) || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(TRIM(AREA)) DESC, START_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT (SELECT DETAIL_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'TUSE' AND CODE_ID = 'BUBYN') AS BUBYN, (SELECT DETAIL_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE CODE_ID = 'HYBRID') AS HYBRID_FM_EXCLUSIONS, (SELECT DETAIL_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE CODE_ID = 'HYB_OK') AS HYBRID_OK_PATTERNS FROM DUAL

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TS.INS_DATE DESC, TS.SERVICE_ID DESC) AS SEQ, TS.SERVICE_ID AS SERVICE_ID, TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REGIST_DATE, TS.PROC_ST AS PROC_ST, CASE WHEN NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'DIRCT' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('C_REQ', 'REQ') THEN 'REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('INPUT', 'SAV') THEN 'SAV' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'W_REQ' THEN 'W_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('B_REQ', 'P_REQ') THEN 'P_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'PREND' THEN 'PREND' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'PBEND' THEN 'PBEND' WHEN TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END' THEN 'P_END' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'S_END', 'D_MAN', 'D_PAM', 'D_DAC') THEN 'S_REQ' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'J_END', 'J_WTX', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON', 'D_DLY', 'D_PAY', 'D_PAQ', 'P_RET', 'END') THEN 'S_END' WHEN TS.PROC_ST IN ('RET', 'REJECT') THEN 'RET' ELSE TS.PROC_ST END AS NPROC_ST, TS.LINK_ID AS LINK_ID, TN.CARID_NO AS CARID_NO, NVL(TS.CAR_NO, TN.CAR_NO) AS CAR_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO AS REQ_CAR_NO, TN.PROC_CD AS PROC_CD, TN.OWNER_NM AS OWNER_NM, CD.CUSTOMER_NM, TN.BUY_AMT AS BUY_AMT, TN.TASK_CD AS ATTACH_TASK_CD, TN.REG_GB AS ATTACH_REG_GB, TN.RATIO_NO AS ATTACH_RATIO_NO, TN.NTAX_TRGET_CD AS ATTACH_NTAX_TRGET_CD, TN.NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD AS ATTACH_NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD, TN.NTAX_WHO AS ATTACH_NTAX_WHO, ( SELECT LISTAGG( SUBSTR( AF2.ATCHSVRFILE_NM, LENGTH(AF2.SERVICE_ID) + 2, INSTR(AF2.ATCHSVRFILE_NM, '.', -1) - LENGTH(AF2.SERVICE_ID) - 2 ), '|' ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY AF2.SEQ) FROM TR_ATTACH_FILE AF2 WHERE AF2.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND SUBSTR(AF2.ATCHSVRFILE_NM, 1, LENGTH(AF2.SERVICE_ID) + 1) = AF2.SERVICE_ID || '_' AND INSTR(AF2.ATCHSVRFILE_NM, '.', -1) > LENGTH(AF2.SERVICE_ID) + 2 ) AS ATTACH_CODES, CASE TN.CARD_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS CARD_YN, NVL(TN.CARD_PAY_YN, 'N') AS CARD_PAY_YN, CASE WHEN NVL(TN.NTAX_TRGET_CD, '00') <> '00' THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS NTAX_YN, TN.PAY_ST AS PAY_ST, TN.PAY_GB AS PAY_GB, TN.CAR_NM AS CAR_NM, TO_CHAR(TN.BPAY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BPAY_DT, TO_CHAR(TN.PAY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PAY_DT, TO_CHAR(TS.INS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INS_DATE, TO_CHAR(TS.JUDGE_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JUDGE_DT, TO_CHAR(CD.INSTALL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSTALL_DT, TB.BRANCH_NM AS SPACE, TRIM( NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(CD.DELIVERY_ADDR), '') || CASE WHEN CD.DELIVERY_ADDR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(CD.DELIVERY_ADDR_DT), '') ELSE '' END ) AS DELIVERY_ADDR, (SELECT MEMBER_NM FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE LOGIN_ID = TS.MEMBER_ID) AS MEMBER_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID AS SU_ID, TS.RETURN_TX AS RETURN_TX, TN.DIRECT_YN AS DIRECT_YN, TO_CHAR(CD.SEND_YN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEND_YN_DT, CD.INSTALL_YN, TS.BRANCH_ID AS BRANCH_ID, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_CARNO_DETACH CD ON CD.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TM_BRANCH TB ON TB.COMPANY_ID = TS.COMPANY_ID AND TB.BRANCH_ID = TS.BRANCH_ID LEFT JOIN TR_OWNERINFO TOI ON TOI.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID WHERE TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TS.PROC_ST <> 'DEL' AND TOI.SEQ = 0 AND TS.COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID}
AND TS.BRANCH_ID = #{BRANCH_ID}
AND TS.MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}
AND TS.BRANCH_ID = #{SPACE_TYPE}
AND TS.JUDGE_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS')
AND TN.INS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS')
AND TS.REQUEST_DT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS')
AND TS.INS_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{START_DT} || '00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(#{END_DT} || '23:59:59', 'YYYYMMDDHH24:MI:SS')
AND ( TN.CARID_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' OR TN.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' OR TN.REQ_CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' OR TS.CAR_NO LIKE '%' || #{CAR_NO} || '%' )
AND TS.LINK_ID LIKE '%' || #{LINK_ID} || '%'
AND (TN.OWNER_NM LIKE '%' || #{CUSTOMER_NM} || '%' OR CD.CUSTOMER_NM LIKE '%' || #{CUSTOMER_NM} || '%' )
AND TN.PAY_GB = #{PAY_GB}
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('C_REQ', 'REQ')
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('INPUT', 'SAV') AND NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'W_REQ'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('B_REQ', 'P_REQ')
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'PREND'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'PBEND'
AND TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('S_REQ', 'S_END', 'J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'D_MAN', 'D_PAM', 'D_DAC')
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('J_END', 'J_WTX', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON', 'D_DLY', 'D_PAY', 'END')
AND NVL(TN.DIRECT_YN, 'N') = 'Y'
AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('RET', 'REJECT')
AND TS.PROC_ST = #{PROC_ST}
AND NVL(CD.INSTALL_YN, 'N') != 'Y'
AND CD.INSTALL_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY TS.INS_DATE DESC, TS.SERVICE_ID DESC

SELECT TN.SERVICE_ID AS SERVICE_ID, NVL(TN.OWNER_NM, '') AS OWNER_NM, CASE WHEN TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'I' THEN '리스' WHEN ( (TN.TASK_CD = 'NORML' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'I') OR (TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'C') ) AND TN.REG_GB IN ('R', 'F') AND NVL(TTR.ETC1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN '개인사업자' WHEN TN.REG_GB IN ('R', 'F') THEN '개인' WHEN TN.REG_GB = 'B' THEN '법인' ELSE '' END AS OWNER_TYPE, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO) AS OWNER_REG_NO, CASE WHEN ( (TN.TASK_CD = 'NORML' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'I') OR (TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'C') ) AND TN.REG_GB IN ('R', 'F') AND NVL(TTR.ETC1, 'N') = 'Y' THEN NVL(TTR.REG_NO, '') WHEN (TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND TN.PROC_CD = 'I') OR TN.REG_GB = 'B' THEN NVL(TN.BIZ_NO, '') ELSE '' END AS OWNER_BIZ_NO, TRIM( NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.ADDRESS), '') || CASE WHEN TN.ADDRESS_DT IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.ADDRESS_DT), '') ELSE '' END ) AS OWNER_ADDRESS, NVL(TRIM(TTR.MAIL1), '') AS OWNER_EMAIL1, NVL(TRIM(TTR.MAIL2), '') AS OWNER_EMAIL2, NVL(TOI.DEBTOR_NM, '') AS JOINT_OWNER_NM, CASE WHEN TOI.DEBTOR_NM IS NULL THEN '' WHEN TOI.DEBTOR_GB IN ('R', 'F') THEN '개인' WHEN TOI.DEBTOR_GB IN ('B', 'C') THEN '법인' ELSE '' END AS JOINT_OWNER_TYPE, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.REG_NO) AS JOINT_OWNER_REG_NO, CASE WHEN TOI.DEBTOR_GB IN ('B', 'C') THEN NVL(TOI.BIZ_NO, '') ELSE '' END AS JOINT_OWNER_BIZ_NO, TRIM( NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.DEBTOR_ADDR), '') || CASE WHEN TOI.DEBTOR_ADDR_DT IS NOT NULL THEN ' ' || NVL(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.DEBTOR_ADDR_DT), '') ELSE '' END ) AS JOINT_OWNER_ADDRESS FROM TR_NEWCAR TN LEFT JOIN TR_OWNERINFO TOI ON TOI.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TOI.SEQ = 0 AND (TN.TASK_CD IS NULL OR TN.TASK_CD <> 'LEASE') LEFT JOIN TR_TAX_RECEIPT TTR ON TTR.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TN.SERVICE_ID IN
#{serviceId}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, PROC_CD, TASK_CD, BOND_YN, BOND_DC, CARID_NO, REG_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(REG_NO) AS REG_NO, BIZ_NO, OWNER_NM, OWNER_BRANCH_ID, POST_NO, BUBJUNG_CD, RETURN_NO, RETURN_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(ADDRESS) AS ADDRESS, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(ADDRESS_DT) AS ADDRESS_DT, BASE_BRANCH_ID, BASE_POST_NO, BASE_BUBJUNG_CD, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(BASE_ADDRESS) AS BASE_ADDRESS, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(BASE_ADDRESS_DT) AS BASE_ADDRESS_DT, RT_ACC_NM, RT_ACC_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TEL_NO) AS TEL_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, PRDTC_CD, REQ_CAR_YN, REQ_CAR_NO, CAR_NO, TO_CHAR(IMSIGV_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS IMSIGV_DT, IMSIGV_CD, IMSINUM_YN, IMSINUM_DT, NUMPLATE_GB, DISTR_YN, DISTR_CD, INSURER_NM, PAY_GB, PAY_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(PAY_HP_NO) AS PAY_HP_NO, PAY_ME, PAY_ST, PAY_DT, TOTAL_AMT, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, BD_SERVICE_ID, NTAX_TRGET_CD, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE, RATIO_NO, MADE_DT, MADE_YY, CAR_CC, GETIN_NO, COLOR_GB, CAR_NM, CAR_KD, CAR_KD_CD, FM_NM, FUEL_CD, BUY_AMT, NTAX_WHO, NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD, NTAX_APPLC_CD, STAMP_GB, INJI_NO, PREREG_AMT, NEWCAR_REG_DT, BOND_AMT, BOND_BANK_CD, BOND_BANK_NO, BOND_LINK_YN, STANDARD_AMT, MEMO_TX, RT_BANK_CD, RT_ACC_NO, RT_ACC_NM, RT_AMT, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(CARP_ADDRESS) AS CARP_ADDRESS, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(CARP_ADDRESS_DT) AS CARP_ADDRESS_DT, CARP_POST_NO, GOVT_TX, CAR_US, SPMNNO, LAST_DT, VH_TY_CD, INSURER_CD, TO_CHAR(INSURER_SDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS INSURER_SDT, TO_CHAR(INSURER_EDT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS INSURER_EDT, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(ADDR_INFO) AS ADDR_INFO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(ADDR_INFO2) AS ADDR_INFO2, LOW_POLLUTION_YN, CONTRACTOR_NM, CARD_YN, TO_CHAR(CONTRACTOR_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CONTRACTOR_DT, TO_CHAR(REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REGIST_DATE FROM TR_NEWCAR WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{serviceId}

SELECT SV.SERVICE_ID FROM TR_SERVICE SV JOIN TR_NEWCAR NC ON SV.SERVICE_ID = NC.SERVICE_ID WHERE NC.CARID_NO = #{CARID_NO} AND SV.PROC_ST IN ('REQ', 'S_END', 'S_REQ', 'P_REQ', 'B_REQ', 'P_END','PBEND', 'PREND', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON','J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'J_END', 'END') AND SV.REQUEST_DT <= SYSDATE

SELECT SV.SERVICE_ID FROM TR_SERVICE SV JOIN TR_NEWCAR NC ON SV.SERVICE_ID = NC.SERVICE_ID WHERE NC.CARID_NO = #{CARID_NO} AND SV.PROC_ST IN ('C_REQ','REQ', 'S_END', 'S_REQ', 'P_REQ', 'B_REQ', 'P_END','PBEND', 'PREND', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON','J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'J_END', 'END') AND SV.REQUEST_DT <= SYSDATE

SELECT SERVICE_ID FROM TR_SERVICE WHERE LINK_ID = #{LINK_ID} AND PROC_ST IN ( 'C_REQ', 'REQ', 'S_END', 'S_REQ', 'P_REQ', 'B_REQ', 'P_END', 'PBEND', 'PREND', 'D_REQ', 'D_ING', 'D_END', 'D_CON', 'J_REQ', 'J_ING', 'J_END', 'END' ) AND REQUEST_DT <= SYSDATE

SELECT COMPANY_ID, BRANCH_ID, BRANCH_NM, BIZ_NO, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, BASE_ID, PAYMENT_ME, REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TEL_NO), '-', '') AS TEL_NO, REPLACE(PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(MPHONE_NO), '-', '') AS MPHONE_NO, NEWCAR_YN, MORTREG_YN, MORTERS_YN, TRNSNAME_YN, USE_YN, BUBJUNG_CD, BUBJUNG_NM, HJD_CD, HJD_NM, ROAD_CD, ROAD_NM, ASSIGN_CD FROM TM_BRANCH WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BRANCH_NM

SELECT COMPANY_ID, BASE_ID, BASE_NM, BIZ_NO, POST_NO, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, BUBJUNG_CD, BUBJUNG_NM, HJD_CD, HJD_NM, ROAD_CD, ROAD_NM, USE_YN, ADDR_INFO FROM TM_COMPANY_BASE WHERE COMPANY_ID = #{COMPANY_ID} ORDER BY CASE WHEN BASE_NM = '직접입력' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, BASE_NM
SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, PROC_ST, REQ_CAR_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN WHERE TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND REQ_CAR_NO = #{REQ_CAR_NO} AND TS.SERVICE_ID <> #{SERVICE_ID}

SELECT SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, TASK_CD AS NUMPLATE_GB, CAR_NO, POST_CAR_NO, FILENAME1, FILENAME2, FILENAME3, FILENAME4, FILENAME5, FILENAME6, OWNER_YN, SEND_YN, RECEIVE_YN, MEMO_TX AS NUM_MEMO_TX, ETC1, ETC2, ETC3, ETC4, ETC5, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE, DELIVERY_GB, DELIVERY_CP, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DELIVERY_ADDR) AS DELIVERY_ADDR, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DELIVERY_ADDR_DT) AS DELIVERY_ADDR_DT, DELIVERY_POST_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(DELIVERY_CP_ADDR) AS DELIVERY_CP_ADDR, TO_CHAR(INSTALL_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS INSTALL_DT, INSTALL_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(INSTALL_TEL_NO) AS INSTALL_TEL_NO, INSTALL_SMS_TX, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(RECEIVE_TEL_NO) AS RECEIVE_TEL_NO, INSTALL_TM, INSTALL_YN, NUMPLATE_ST, LAST_DELIVERY_GB, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR) AS LAST_DELIVERY_ADDR, LAST_DELIVERY_POST_NO, DELIVERY_BC, RENT_SEND_YN, RENT_RECEIVE_YN, TO_CHAR(SEND_YN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SEND_YN_DT, TO_CHAR(RECEIVE_YN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RECEIVE_YN_DT, TO_CHAR(RENT_SEND_YN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RENT_SEND_YN_DT, TO_CHAR(RENT_RECEIVE_YN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RENT_RECEIVE_YN_DT, SONGJANG_NO, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(STATUS_SMS_NO) AS STATUS_SMS_NO, RECEIVE_NM, CUSTOMER_NM, HOLE_YN, SEAL_YN, TOKEN FROM TR_CARNO_DETACH WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.CARID_NO, CASE WHEN TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND NVL(TN.PROC_CD, 'I') != 'C' THEN TOI.DEBTOR_NM ELSE TN.OWNER_NM END AS BUY_NM, CASE WHEN TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND NVL(TN.PROC_CD, 'I') != 'C' THEN PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.REG_NO) ELSE PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.REG_NO) END AS REG_NO, CASE WHEN TN.TASK_CD = 'LEASE' AND NVL(TN.PROC_CD, 'I') != 'C' THEN TOI.BIZ_NO ELSE TN.BIZ_NO END AS BIZ_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TN.SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID LEFT JOIN TR_OWNERINFO TOI ON TOI.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TOI.SEQ = 0 WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_ATTACH_FILE ( SERVICE_ID, ATCHFILEPATH_NM, ATCHFILE_NM, SEQ, ATCHSVRFILE_NM, GUBUN, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{ATCHFILEPATH_NM}, #{ATCHFILE_NM}, #{SEQ}, #{ATCHSVRFILE_NM}, #{GUBUN}, #{INS_USER}, SYSDATE, #{UPD_USER}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TR_NEWCAR ( SERVICE_ID, WORK_CD, PROC_CD, TASK_CD, BOND_YN, BOND_DC, CARID_NO, REG_GB, REG_NO, BIZ_NO, OWNER_NM, OWNER_BRANCH_ID, POST_NO, BUBJUNG_CD, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DT, BASE_BRANCH_ID, BASE_POST_NO, BASE_BUBJUNG_CD, BASE_ADDRESS, BASE_ADDRESS_DT, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO, PRDTC_CD, REQ_CAR_YN, REQ_CAR_NO, CAR_NO, IMSIGV_DT, IMSIGV_CD, IMSINUM_YN, IMSINUM_DT, NUMPLATE_GB, DISTR_YN, DISTR_CD, INSURER_NM, PAY_GB, PAY_NM, PAY_HP_NO, PAY_ME, PAY_ST, PAY_DT, TOTAL_AMT, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, T_VBANK_GB, T_VBANK_ID, BD_SERVICE_ID, NTAX_TRGET_CD, INS_USER, INS_DATE, RATIO_NO, MADE_DT, MADE_YY, CAR_CC, GETIN_NO, COLOR_GB, CAR_NM, CAR_KD, CAR_KD_CD, FM_NM, FUEL_CD, BUY_AMT, NTAX_WHO, NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD, NTAX_APPLC_CD, STAMP_GB, INJI_NO, PREREG_AMT, NEWCAR_REG_DT, BOND_AMT, BOND_BANK_CD, BOND_BANK_NO, BOND_LINK_YN, STANDARD_AMT, MEMO_TX, RT_BANK_CD, RT_ACC_NO, RT_ACC_NM, RT_AMT, CARP_ADDRESS, GOVT_TX, CARP_ADDRESS_DT, CARP_POST_NO, VH_TY_CD, INSURER_CD, INSURER_SDT, INSURER_EDT, ADDR_INFO, ADDR_INFO2, LOW_POLLUTION_YN, CONTRACTOR_NM, CONTRACTOR_DT, CARD_YN, REGIST_DATE, RETURN_NO, RETURN_NM, DIRECT_YN ) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{WORK_CD}, #{PROC_CD}, #{TASK_CD}, #{BOND_YN}, #{BOND_DC}, #{CARID_NO}, #{REG_GB}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{REG_NO}), #{BIZ_NO}, #{OWNER_NM}, #{OWNER_BRANCH_ID}, #{POST_NO}, #{BUBJUNG_CD}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{ADDRESS}), PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{ADDRESS_DT}), #{BASE_BRANCH_ID}, #{BASE_POST_NO}, #{BASE_BUBJUNG_CD}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{BASE_ADDRESS}), PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{BASE_ADDRESS_DT}), PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{TEL_NO}), PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{MPHONE_NO}), #{PRDTC_CD}, #{REQ_CAR_YN}, #{REQ_CAR_NO}, #{CAR_NO}, #{IMSIGV_DT}, #{IMSIGV_CD}, #{IMSINUM_YN}, #{IMSINUM_DT}, #{NUMPLATE_GB}, #{DISTR_YN}, #{DISTR_CD}, #{INSURER_NM}, #{PAY_GB}, #{PAY_NM}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{PAY_HP_NO}), #{PAY_ME}, #{PAY_ST}, #{PAY_DT}, #{TOTAL_AMT}, #{VBANK_CD}, #{VBANK_NO}, #{T_VBANK_GB}, #{T_VBANK_ID}, #{BD_SERVICE_ID}, #{NTAX_TRGET_CD}, #{MEMBER_ID}, SYSDATE, #{RATIO_NO}, #{MADE_DT}, #{MADE_YY}, #{CAR_CC}, #{GETIN_NO}, #{COLOR_GB}, #{CAR_NM}, #{CAR_KD}, #{CAR_KD_CD}, #{FM_NM}, #{FUEL_CD}, #{BUY_AMT}, #{NTAX_WHO}, #{NTAX_TRGET_GR_CD}, #{NTAX_APPLC_CD}, #{STAMP_GB}, #{INJI_NO}, #{PREREG_AMT}, #{NEWCAR_REG_DT}, #{BOND_AMT}, #{BOND_BANK_CD}, #{BOND_BANK_NO}, #{BOND_LINK_YN}, #{STANDARD_AMT}, #{MEMO_TX}, #{RT_BANK_CD}, #{RT_ACC_NO}, #{RT_ACC_NM}, #{RT_AMT}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{CARP_ADDRESS}), #{GOVT_TX}, PKG_COMMON.FN_ENCRYPT(#{CARP_ADDRESS_DT}), #{CARP_POST_NO},
